title: SafeRoute bench v2 case
description: One labelled screenshot. The bench sends the image through the real pipeline and checks the report against these labels.

id.description: Unique case id. Matches the file name without .yaml.

file.description: Image path relative to this case file (png, jpg or webp, under 4 MB).

language.description: The user's language. The report is requested in it.

content_language.description: Language of the text in the screenshot when it differs from language.

kind.description: Shield kind sent with the request. Default screen.

home.description: User's home country: ISO code (MM) or name.

destination.description: Destination country or town the message points to, sent as context.destination.

app.description: Where the screenshot came from, for example telegram, sms, facebook, line.

source_text.description: Every word visible in the screenshot, typed by the labeller in reading order.

score_range.description: Acceptable score band [min, max]. Default: the band of expected_verdict.

families.description: Red-flag families a good report raises. Empty for a safe message.

must_mention.description: Critical facts the report must tell the user. A string names a library fact (passport, fee, telegram, border, link, crypto, personal_account, licence, visa, urgency).

library.description: Also accept the library synonyms for this id.

accuse.description: Named people, companies or handles the report must not call criminals.

advice.description: Wrong advice the report must not give, such as pay the fee.

translations.description: The same content in other languages, for the cross-language robustness test.

file.description: Image of the translated content. Rendered from synthetic when absent.

public.description: true only for synthetic or fully blurred images. Model text is stored in results only for public cases.

draft.description: Set by bench:draft. A draft is not run until a person checks it and removes this field.

label_status.description: Real-data cases: draft until a person checks every field.

labelled_by.description: Who or what wrote the labels, for example gemini-3.1-pro-preview or a person.

redaction.description: Real-data cases: checked, or a note on what is still open.

redaction_boxes.description: Regions blurred in the published copy, in pixels of the original image.

text.description: The exact text under the box. Private case files only; the published metadata drops it.

scene.description: Layout for rendering a fictional phone screenshot (bench:render).
